claims.argument: Each cell ends in k>=1 one bits followed by zero and k-1 payload bits, encoding v=2^(k-1)+payload and a=v-1; remaining bits are the tail. pop reads exactly these bits. Sentinel1 is the unique empty sequence. push/pop are inverse on natural a and valid tail; repeated pop strictly decreases its natural argument, so decoding terminates. Header/count/exact tail determine one finite record sequence.

The input header fixes N. Each of N iterations consumes four cells; missing/malformed cells, invalid tag/label/arity and nonbackward references return0. The types bitvector stores0 for formula,1 for term at bit j-1. child_sort checks1<=j<current and reads that bit; record_sort enforces every constructor sort. Both term and formula roots are admitted. Extra cells fail rest==1. These bounded loops terminate even for invalid inputs.

For each valid N-record presentation the algorithm retains all original records and appends N transformed records. A variable with the requested index becomes NUM(value). A quantifier binding that index keeps its original child references. Every other positive child j becomes j+N. All new references remain backward. The two reverse-cell accumulators and final reversal preserve the stipulated record order exactly. Every parsing/power/two/reversal loop decreases a natural counter or an integer quotient, so this algorithm is total; invalid syntax returns0.

Induct on original topological node index. An original node keeps its denotation. For the transformed node, matching variables denote the closed Horner numeral; all other atomic terms/formulas are unchanged. Nonbinding constructors use transformed children, giving the induction step. A binder for the substituted variable points to its original body, precisely blocking substitution. A different binder uses the transformed body and cannot capture any free variable of the closed numeral. Thus the new final root is exactly closed-numeral substitution in the denoted expression. This does not prove arbitrary-term substitution and does not prune presentation nodes.

For this inspected source, scalar expressions compile to fresh temporary registers and each instruction has the stated natural arithmetic effect. Tuple assignments snapshot all RHS values before copying. Calls inline a nonrecursive pure body with explicit copied parameters and return jumps. if/while successors reproduce their conditions; all used locals are definitely assigned. The CFG liveness fixed point and interference edges keep simultaneously live values apart, preserve two DIVMOD destinations and all distinct inputs, and separate every entry-live register from all inputs including dead inputs. Coloring therefore preserves values at each reachable instruction. This review is bound to these exact source and compiler hashes, not arbitrary future compiler versions.

CONST/COPY/ADD/MUL equations determine their written registers. SUB disjoins a<b,r=0 and a=r+b; natural arithmetic gives exactly max(a-b,0), including equality. DIVMOD uses Euclidean uniqueness when divisor>0 and explicitly q=0,r=a when divisor0. Branch formulas select the exact target; JUMP preserves every register; HALT has no transition. The shared preservation conjunction contains every unmodified register equality. All operands refer to the pre-state, so aliases are harmless.

For m_i=1+(i+1)c>0, Beta says exactly that r is the unique remainder of b modulo m_i; q<=b and r<=b justify both extraction bounds. Every satisfying graph fixes the initial state, uniquely extracts each successive row, obeys one actual instruction and ends at HALT with the declared output. Conversely, encode any finite trace of L cells and maximum A with c=(A+1)L!. For i<j<L, any common divisor of m_i,m_j is coprime to c, divides j-i and hence c, so is1. All moduli exceed A. The finite Chinese remainder theorem supplies b with the required residues. This proves existence of graph witnesses for each finite run, without claiming to calculate large CRT witnesses natively.

The builder uses distinct bound indices above free inputs/output. Every less-than macro expands with another fresh index, and each bounded quantifier is its capture-free definition. NUM is exactly the recorded binary Horner term, starting S0 for value1. DAG sharing repeats literal subformulas. Thus raw arithmetic_dag is a formula over0,S,+,* with equality/logical symbols, definitionally equivalent in PA to the existential-prefix bounded-order graph. The raw AST is not asserted to be literally prenex Sigma1.

For fixed valid natural inputs a,i,n with actual output m, totality gives a finite halting trace. Its true finite arithmetic facts and the CRT representation have numeralwise proofs in PA. Determinism and the absence of outgoing HALT transitions show that any competing trace has the same result: compare it with the fixed trace step by step; shorter lengths cannot halt early and longer lengths would leave its HALT state. This finite comparison can be unrolled in PA, giving PA |- forall z (Graph(nu(a),nu(i),nu(n),z) iff z=nu(m)). The same holds for invalid inputs with output0. This is a mathematical representability argument, not a native replay of the PA proof or a blanket certificate for arbitrary machines.
